Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and compared inconsistent release dates, using Saajan Bina Suhagan’s later US release (1983) instead of its earliest documented release (India, 1978) shown on IMDb, while using Taxi zum Klo’s earliest 1980 premiere. This led to the incorrect interim conclusion that Taxi zum Klo was released first.
